data.one_liner: JSON serialization and data classes generator supporting generics, inheritance, and customization.
data.what_it_does: Generates JSON serialization, equality operators, hashCode, toString, and copyWith methods for Dart classes and enums. It excels at handling complex use cases such as polymorphism, type inheritance, and generics.
use_when: You need robust JSON serialization that handles complex class inheritance and generics.
You want built-in data class features like copyWith, equality, and toString alongside JSON mapping.
avoid_when: You want zero build-runner or code generation setup in your project.
You are already heavily invested in json_serializable or freezed and don't require dart_mappable's advanced generic and inheritance features.
strengths: Full support for generics, polymorphism, and inheritance.
All-in-one package generating serialization, equality, toString, and copyWith.
Highly flexible with mapping hooks and custom configuration options.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation.
toJson() returns a String rather than a Map<String, dynamic>, which requires attention when migrating from other packages.
data.setup_notes: Add dart_mappable as a dependency and dart_mappable_builder and build_runner as dev_dependencies, then run dart run build_runner build.

alternatives.name: json_serializable
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard Map-based toJson returns and standard JSON annotation configurations.

alternatives.name: freezed
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want union types and pattern matching features for immutable data models.
